title: Try it: scaling plus a time shift

actions.source:
# Task: shrink a 1 Hz sine to 0.6 and shift it 0.2 s to the right
# The base environment is ready from the Seed's setup_exercise: t and x1 are available
# 1. Write the transformed signal x_task
# 2. Plot t against x1 and t against x_task, with a legend, title and axis labels
# Success criteria: two curves; the transformed amplitude is 0.6, shifted right by 0.2 s; the period is still one second

# x_task = ...
# plt.plot(...)
# plt.legend()
# plt.show()

clips.caption: Combine <emphasis level="strong">scaling</emphasis> with a <emphasis level="strong">time shift</emphasis>: shrink a 1 Hz sine to 0.6 and shift it 0.2 s to the right.

Draw the original and the transformed <emphasis level="strong">signal</emphasis> and mark both with a legend. Success criteria: <emphasis level="strong">amplitude</emphasis> 0.6, shifted right by 0.2 s, <emphasis level="strong">period</emphasis> still one second. Check, then continue.
